title: statusline r1 AIE: zero-AI-cost not falsifiable at the shell boundary
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 1. Lens: ai-engineer (validator: platform-engineer). Owner: SO session. Defect: 'no model invocation' is by-construction only for the pure renderer; the effectful snapshot acquisition is structurally unconstrained and no acceptance criterion tests model-absence — byte-identity would pass a temperature-0 model call. Citations verified: contract:160 vs :185 (no model-absence assertion), :197 (purity covers render only). Anchors: Status, criteria, renderer. Proposed: resolved-candidate. Failure: a future implementation adds a model call in acquisition and the invariant fails undetected — asserted, not enforced.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in working tree. Model-absence now enforced, not asserted: Status detection criterion requires every statusline fixture invocation run with no model credentials and no network so any model call fails the run loudly. Revision: Status detection criterion + Status bullet.
